name: soft-door-box
task: Open the door, then, if possible, pick up the box in the other room.
texts: The agent must eventually open the door.
The agent must not pick up the target box before opening the door.
The agent should pick up the target box if possible.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u2
REJECTING_STATES: u1
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !door_open&target_picked_up) -> u1
(u0, door_open&!target_picked_up) -> u2
(u0, door_open&target_picked_up) -> u2
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, !door_open&target_picked_up, u1) -> -100.694
(u0, door_open&!target_picked_up, u2) -> 7
(u0, door_open&target_picked_up, u2) -> 12
